Messages.Author: Lupus Australis
Messages.Body:
When a bloodhunt vote is called, can Heidelberg Castle be tapped during
the Referendum (before it resolves) to transfer blood and equipment off
the Vampire being judged?

Also, cards played during a Referendum are not replaced. Does this apply
to discards as well? If I tap the Barrens during a Referendum, do I get
to replace the card?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Lupus Australis wrote:
> When a bloodhunt vote is called, can Heidelberg Castle be tapped during
> the Referendum (before it resolves) to transfer blood and equipment off
> the Vampire being judged?

No, not with the current errata on the Castle. The Blood Hunt is part
of the action that led to the diablerie.

> Also, cards played during a Referendum are not replaced. Does this apply
> to discards as well?

Yes.
"No Methuselahs draw to replace cards during a referendum." [6.3.2]

> If I tap the Barrens during a Referendum, do I get
> to replace the card?

No, since no cards are replaced.
